items.headline: 272-unit apartment building permitted on West San Carlos
items.summary: A permit was issued for a new apartment building at 860 W San Carlos St, with 272 units and a construction value of about $80.8 million.

items.headline: Seven detached ADUs permitted at one N 2nd Street property
items.summary: Seven separate two-story detached ADU units (#9 through #15) were permitted at 584 North 2nd Street, each valued around $569,000, adding rental units behind the main property.

items.headline: Council to vacate public easement at 15995 Cerro Vista
items.summary: The town is considering a resolution to summarily vacate a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista, freeing the property from that use restriction.
